title: I found information I'd completely forgotten about with this hidden Gemini feature
content_html:
Published Aug 10, 2026, 7:00 AM EDT

I cover Android with a focus on productivity, automation, and Google’s ecosystem, including Gemini and everyday apps. With a background in engineering and software development, I tend to go beyond surface-level tips and focus on how features fit into real workflows.
Before joining AP, I wrote for tech publications such as Gizbot in 2023 and iJunkie (formerly known as iPhoneHacks) from 2021 to 2022.

I used to waste too much time looking for information I knew was somewhere in my Google account.

Sometimes it was buried in an old Gmail conversation. Other times, it was hidden inside a Google Drive document.

No matter how many searches I tried, finding the right file often felt like guesswork.

Then I discovered a Gemini feature that changed everything. Instead of making me remember where something was saved, it found the answer for me.

Now, it's the first thing I use whenever an email or file seems impossible to track down.

Google Drive search only works if you know what you're looking for

The problem with relying on filenames and keywords

If you've been using Google Drive for years, chances are you've accumulated hundreds of documents, PDFs, spreadsheets, and presentations.

Drive's built-in search is fast and supports filters such as file type, owner, and modification date. But it still expects you to know something about the file you're trying to find, whether it's a keyword in the title, a phrase in the document, or who shared it with you.

Often, I remember the information I need, but not where I saved it. Maybe it was mentioned in an email, attached as a PDF, or referenced in a document with a completely unrelated filename.

In those situations, searching Drive alone means trying different keywords, opening multiple files to see if one of them contains the answer.

Gemini takes a different approach. Instead of relying on exact keywords, it lets you describe what you're looking for in plain language.

It can also look beyond Drive by using Gmail or Google Calendar as context, making it easier to uncover information that's scattered across emails and files.

How Gemini connects Google Drive and other Workspace apps

It searches across all applications

One of the biggest advantages of Ask Gemini is that it doesn't treat Google Drive and other Workspace apps as separate. It can search across all of them at the same time, using emails, attachments, documents, PDFs, spreadsheets, and folders as context for my question.

That means I no longer have to remember whether an important detail was in an email or inside a Drive file.

To use it, open Google Drive and click Ask Gemini (sparkle icon) in the upper-right corner.

Gemini can also search other Workspace apps like Gmail, Calendar, and Google Chat, so you can ask questions in plain English instead of relying on keywords.

For example, I could ask, "Summarize everything related to the website redesign from my emails and Drive files" or "Find the PDF John emailed me about our marketing budget."

Gemini scans the relevant sources, connects information across them, and cites where it found each answer, making it easy to verify the results.

Availability varies by account, region, and rollout. Some users may have access on free accounts, while others may need an eligible Gemini or Google Workspace plan.

It uncovers details I had completely forgotten

I stopped overlooking important information

One of the biggest reasons I've started relying on Gemini in Drive is that it finds information I didn't even remember existed.

A quick question often brings together an email from months ago, a meeting on my calendar, or a document in Drive that I'd completely forgotten about.

That's useful when I'm trying to remember decisions rather than locate files.

Instead of searching for a document with the right keyword, I can ask Gemini something like, "What did we decide about the website redesign?" or "Summarize everything related to my meeting with Amy."

Gemini pulls together the relevant context from across supported Workspace apps and links back to the sources so I can verify the information myself.

In many cases, the answer isn't hidden in a single email or document; it's spread across several. Gemini connects conversations, files, chats, and calendar events, reminding me of forgotten details.

You can also verify where Gemini found the answer

Trace everything back to its source

Gemini doesn't only give you an answer; it also shows where that answer came from. After generating a response, you can view the citations in the text or at the bottom of the answer to see which emails, documents, PDFs, chats, or other Workspace content contributed to it.

That makes it easy to jump to the original file or conversation if you want more context or need to verify a specific detail.

I find this helpful when Gemini summarizes information from multiple places. Rather than wondering whether it interpreted something correctly, I can review the sources myself.

Ask Gemini can search across your Google Workspace, but you're in control of where it looks. After opening Gemini in Google Drive, enable Let Gemini search for sources and choose the specific sources you want it to use.

If you only want results from your Drive files, you can turn off other sources. This makes it easy to broaden or narrow Gemini's search depending on what you're trying to find.

Gemini has become my default way of searching Workspace apps

I still use traditional search when I know exactly what I'm looking for. But when I don't remember where I saved it, Gemini is almost always faster.

Instead of switching between Gmail, Drive, Chat, and Calendar, I can ask a single question and let it connect the dots for me.

This underrated feature saves time in a genuinely practical way, and after using it, going back to keyword searches feels unnecessarily limiting.

content_html_zh:
发布于 2026 年 8 月 10 日，东部夏令时间上午 7:00

我介绍 Android 时，重点关注生产力、自动化和 Google 生态系统，包括 Gemini 和日常应用程序。 凭借工程和软件开发的背景，我倾向于超越表面技巧，而专注于功能如何融入实际工作流程。 在加入 AP 之前，我曾为科技出版物撰写文章，例如 2023 年为 Gizbot 撰写文章，2021 年至 2022 年为 iJunkie（以前称为 iPhoneHacks）撰写文章。

我过去常常浪费太多时间寻找我知道在我的 Google 帐户中某处的信息。

有时它被隐藏在旧的 Gmail 对话中。 其他时候，它隐藏在 Google Drive 文档中。

无论我尝试了多少次搜索，找到正确的文件通常都像是猜测。

然后我发现了双子座的一个特征改变了一切。 它没有让我记住东西保存在哪里，而是为我找到了答案。

现在，每当电子邮件或文件似乎无法追踪时，它就是我使用的第一件事。

仅当您知道自己要查找什么时，Google 云端硬盘搜索才有效

依赖文件名和关键字的问题

如果您多年来一直使用 Google 云端硬盘，那么您很可能已经积累了数百个文档、PDF、电子表格和演示文稿。

云端硬盘的内置搜索速度很快，并且支持文件类型、所有者和修改日期等过滤器。 但它仍然希望您了解有关您要查找的文件的信息，无论是标题中的关键字、文档中的短语还是与您共享该文件的人。

通常，我记得我需要的信息，但不记得我保存它的位置。 也许它在电子邮件中被提及，以 PDF 形式附加，或者在文件名完全不相关的文档中被引用。

在这些情况下，单独搜索云端硬盘意味着尝试不同的关键字、打开多个文件以查看其中一个文件是否包含答案。

双子座采取了不同的方法。 它可以让您用简单的语言描述您正在寻找的内容，而不是依赖于确切的关键字。

它还可以使用 Gmail 或 Google 日历作为上下文，超越云端硬盘的范围，从而更轻松地发现分散在电子邮件和文件中的信息。

Gemini 如何连接 Google Drive 和其他 Workspace 应用程序

它搜索所有应用程序

Ask Gemini 的最大优势之一是它不会将 Google Drive 和其他 Workspace 应用程序分开对待。 它可以同时搜索所有内容，使用电子邮件、附件、文档、PDF、电子表格和文件夹作为我的问题的上下文。

这意味着我不再需要记住重要的详细信息是在电子邮件中还是在云端硬盘文件中。

要使用它，请打开 Google Drive，然后单击右上角的“询问 Gemini”（闪烁图标）。

Gemini 还可以搜索其他 Workspace 应用程序，例如 Gmail、日历和 Google Chat，因此您可以用简单的英语提问，而不必依赖关键字。

例如，我可以问“从我的电子邮件和云端硬盘文件中总结与网站重新设计相关的所有内容”或“查找约翰通过电子邮件发送给我的有关我们营销预算的 PDF 文件”。

Gemini 会扫描相关来源，将它们之间的信息连接起来，并引用它在哪里找到每个答案，从而轻松验证结果。

可用性因帐户、区域和部署而异。 部分用户可能可以使用免费帐号，而其他用户可能需要符合条件的 Gemini 或 Google Workspace 套餐。

它揭示了我完全忘记的细节

我不再忽视重要信息

我开始依赖云端硬盘中的 Gemini 的最大原因之一是它可以找到我什至不记得存在的信息。

一个简单的问题通常会汇集几个月前的一封电子邮件、日历上的一次会议或云端硬盘中我完全忘记的文档。

当我试图记住决定而不是查找文件时，这很有用。

我可以问 Gemini 类似的问题，“我们对网站重新设计做出了什么决定？”，而不是搜索具有正确关键字的文档。 或“总结与我与艾米会面有关的所有内容。”

Gemini 将受支持的 Workspace 应用程序中的相关上下文汇集在一起​​，并链接回源，以便我可以自己验证信息。

在许多情况下，答案并不隐藏在一封电子邮件或文档中；而是隐藏在其中。它分布在几个地方。 Gemini 连接对话、文件、聊天和日历事件，提醒我忘记的细节。

您还可以验证 Gemini 是在哪里找到答案的

一切都可以追溯到它的源头

双子座不仅给你答案，而且给你答案。它还显示了该答案的来源。 生成回复后，您可以查看文本中或答案底部的引文，以查看哪些电子邮件、文档、PDF、聊天或其他 Workspace 内容对此做出了贡献。

如果您想要更多上下文或需要验证特定细节，这可以轻松跳转到原始文件或对话。

当双子座总结来自多个地方的信息时，我发现这很有帮助。 我可以自己查看来源，而不是想知道它是否正确解释了某些内容。

Ask Gemini 可以在您的 Google Workspace 中进行搜索，但您可以控制它的显示位置。 在 Google Drive 中打开 Gemini 后，启用让 Gemini 搜索源并选择您希望其使用的特定源。

如果您只需要云端硬盘文件的结果，则可以关闭其他来源。 这使得您可以根据您想要查找的内容轻松扩大或缩小 Gemini 的搜索范围。

Gemini 已成为我搜索 Workspace 应用程序的默认方式

当我确切地知道我在寻找什么时，我仍然使用传统搜索。 但当我不记得在哪里保存时，Gemini 几乎总是更快。

我无需在 Gmail、云端硬盘、聊天和日历之间切换，只需提出一个问题，然后让它为我连接各个点。

这个被低估的功能以真正实用的方式节省了时间，并且在使用它之后，返回关键字搜索会感觉不必要的限制。
